visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with auburn hair in twin braids, wearing a white sleeveless lace dress, stands in a professional music studio. She smiles and opens her arms wide in a welcoming gesture. Behind her are a large marimba and a black grand piano against dark acoustic paneled walls. (2) Two young boys in white polo shirts are shown; one is hugging the other from behind as they talk and smile. The scene has a dark background with ember-like visual effects and large white and yellow text overlays. (3) Two men in business suits, one brown and one blue, stand together talking to the camera. They appear confident and are positioned in front of the same music studio background with warm indoor lighting. (4) Close-up shots of the boys interacting; one wears large black headphones and gestures with his hands while speaking. Colorful variety-style text and graphic icons pop up around them as they laugh. (5) The woman in the white dress returns, playfully swatting a boy's back with a rolled-up paper while the adult man in the brown suit laughs nearby. The lighting is bright and the atmosphere is lighthearted. (6) A close-up shot of the young boy in a white shirt speaking directly to the camera with a mischievous smile. He is standing in front of a piano in a well-lit room. (7) Multiple close-up shots of four hands playing the marimba with mallets. The two men in suits are shown playing a fast-paced piece together with focused expressions.
